verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox or test workspace for Linear data. There is no isolated API environment and nothing that keeps experiments separate from production workspace data. Cloud coding sessions, where Linear Agent sets up, runs and tests code, are an execution environment for the user's own code. They make no claim of isolation from production data and are not a sandbox for testing against Linear, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
